text_block_list.text:
The cherry blossoms are in full bloom for
this
year's Oka Sho!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Who will win the tiara today? Only time
will tell!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон... She ran in the Hanshin
J.F., right?
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Apparently. I heard she's a strong
contender for
the Triple Tiara this year.
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
There's quite a number of spectators in
the stands
who are looking forward to
seeing Хиши Амадзон
race.

Meanwhile, Хиши Амадзон herself is a
little
distracted.

Ack! Sorry about that. I just zoned out
for a
second!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Well... Don't laugh at what I'm about to
tell you,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I know I chose the Tiara to prove I was
worthy of
challenging Brian and all,
but...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Now that I've come all this way, it feels
like...
I'unno.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I kinda feel like I was meant for this
path—that
this is the start of a whole
new me.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Man, what am I even saying?! Forget all
of that!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I've gotta focus on winning this first!
Here I go,
full steam ahead!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон heads into the Oka Sho
with a
wide, courageous grin!
